title: GNX raids.json
description: The mod's own raid stages. In progress: stages are registered and saved with the game, not yet shown on the raid map or playable.

id.description: Name of the stage inside the mod; other mods and saves refer to it as "<mod folder>.<id>".

label.description: Name shown to the player (default: id).

pos.description: [x, y] of the stage button on the raid map.

icon.description: PNG in sprites/ for the stage button.

unlock.description: Quest condition that discovers the stage.

raid_time.description: Frames from the nest to the stage (vanilla 2760-5100; default 3600).

levels.description: One entry per level the player can pick.

level.description: One level of a stage. Its keys (units, enemy_ap, boss, gold, food, loot, no_capture, xp) come with the encounter support.
